cause_subject: duration: treat an unknown unit as the base unit instead of raising
bug_report: parse_size crashes on an unrecognised unit. parse_size('10pb') raises instead of returning a value — any size string with a unit we don't have in the table blows up and takes the whole import down. Please make parse_size handle an unknown unit gracefully, consistent with how the rest of the library parses. A failing repro is at tests/test_regression.py.
